name: ai_spend_by_provider
def:
SELECT (date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date AS jour,
    provider_id,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'success'::text)) AS appels_reussis,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'error'::text)) AS appels_en_echec,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'skipped'::text)) AS fournisseurs_ecartes,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (status = 'blocked'::text)) AS appels_bloques,
    COALESCE(sum(input_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS jetons_entree,
    COALESCE(sum(output_tokens), (0)::bigint) AS jetons_sortie,
    COALESCE(sum(cost_usd), (0)::numeric) AS cout_usd
   FROM ai_call_log
  GROUP BY ((date_trunc('day'::text, created_at))::date), provider_id;
